text:
GTP::parse
Description
Creates a new GTP message from a byte stream. Returns a TCL object of type “GTP-Message”
See also
GTP::new
Syntax
GTP
::
parse
<
byte-stream
>
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
set
payload
[
UDP
::
payload
]
set
t2
[
GTP
::
parse
$payload
]
log
local0.
"GTP type [GTP::header type -message $t2]"
log
local0.
"GTP teid [GTP::header teid -message $t2]"
}
